items.title: Joe Lyde Interview, 1959-05-18
items.q: I had an idea that George Lewis and all played here... I asked him about the clarinet player, Lewis, and he said, oh yes, Lewis. Never heard the name.

ctx.x: You just didn't know how many.

I knew the Eureka existed. That's the end of it. That was all I knew. I didn't even know they still marched. I had an idea that George Lewis and all played here. They weren't here. When I got here, they didn't get here for several months after I arrived, and they weren't all that good. I didn't think at the time. Of course, I've been initiated now to appreciate the finer points, I guess, by knowing what to listen for. You know, I was listening for a different thing when I got here.
Excuse me, what bands did bands or and, or whichever way it goes, and or, did you hear in your home? I mean, records mostly. I mean, you probably heard some bands.
